candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly for characters, locations, and proper nouns from the Harry Potter universe.
This feature vector activates on common Romance-language derivational suffixes and adverbial endings, particularly those related to abstract nouns and adverbs in Portuguese, Italian, and English.
This vector represents various conjugated forms and inflections of the Portuguese verb "ser" (to be).
This vector represents morphological variations, inflections, and roots of Portuguese words containing the letter sequence "iv" (or related adjectival and verbal suffixes).
These tokens represent transitive or intransitive verbs frequently followed by prepositional phrases starting with "to," "on," or "upon."
This feature vector represents human demographic categories across different ages and genders.
This feature vector represents theatrical and narrative entertainment genres and storytelling arts.

This feature vector activates strongly on proper names, particularly female given names, alongside words containing root morphemes related to personal relationships, historical eras, or social titles.
This vector represents common word roots, prefixes, and grammatical forms in Romance languages, particularly Spanish and Portuguese.
This vector represents Portuguese adverbs and quantifiers used to express degree, frequency, and amount.
